attr.title: Leisure Suit Larry: Love for Sail!
attr.desc: Larry Laffer is on a cruise ship and wants to win the captain's contest and the girls on board. A comic point-and-click style adventure for mobile phones, with puzzles, inventory items and minigames such as Spank-a-Monkey. Runs the original J2ME game on a MIDP shim with SDL2 video.
attr.inst: Copy your own Leisure Suit Larry: Love for Sail! J2ME game file (.jar, any phone version, any file name) into ports/loveforsail.
